stories.name: Chromatic Lantern
stories.title: A lantern of six colours
stories.text: In a pawnshop window, a brass lantern burns with a light that shifts through the colours of mana. The pawnbroker says it was found in an Izzet district, lighting something it should not. An archivist at New Prahv has offered a reward for it.

outcome.text: The pawnbroker wraps the lantern, and its light points toward an Izzet district.

choices.text: Ask to hold it a moment

outcome.text: You lift the lantern, and its light flares in your hands.

huge_success.text: The light settles into a steady beam, and the pawnbroker, unnerved, gives it to you for free.

success.text: The lantern chooses you, and the pawnbroker lets you go with it.

failure.text: The light burns your fingers, and the pawnbroker locks it away.

huge_failure.text: The flare blinds you, and you knock over a shelf you must pay for.

outcome.text: The lantern flickers as you walk away.

stories.name: Civic Saber
stories.title: A blade that answers to the guilds
stories.text: A guildless smith is selling a saber with a hilt of many-coloured enamel. It is sharper, she says, in the hands of someone who stands with the guilds. Those without a signet carry it instead.

outcome.text: The enamel glows at your touch, and she sells it to you at a guild price.
She buckles the saber to your belt.
She sighs and lets you try your luck at the price.

success.text: She throws up her hands and sells it for a song.

failure.text: She tires of you and sells the saber to someone else.

stories.name: Street Sweeper
stories.intro: A brass street sweeper rolls down the lane, scrubbing away refuse with spinning brushes. It does not slow for anything too clumsy to move. Its brushes turn toward you.
stories.win: The sweeper's gears click into a new pattern, and it trundles after you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: The brushes scrub you into the gutter with the rest of the refuse.
stories.flee: You leap clear, and it sweeps on down the lane.

stories.name: Codex Shredder
stories.title: A machine that eats books
stories.text: A shredder in an archive eats one page at a time, and the archivist is not sure it ever stops. It can also return what it has eaten, for a price. It chews a page and hums.

success.text: It chews contentedly, and the archivist lets you take it home.

huge_failure.text: It eats your sleeve and your purse.

outcome.text: She is glad to see it go.
The archivist rents it out to clerks with secrets. She pays you a cut each time you come by.

stories.name: Pithing Needle
stories.title: A needle for the nerves
stories.text: A Rakdos chirurgeon offers a procedure with a long needle. The fearful want it before a blood festival, she says, and the guilty after. It stops one thing from working.

outcome.text: She hands it over, wrapped in leather.

success.text: It does not hurt, and she gives you the needle after.

huge_failure.text: It hurts, and she charges extra.

outcome.text: You leave before she can insist.

stories.name: Tablet of the Guilds
stories.title: Ten symbols in stone
stories.text: A stone tablet in a plaza bears the symbols of all ten guilds. The Azorius paid well, they say, for their symbol to sit at the top. Touching two symbols at once is said to bring luck.

outcome.text: The tablet warms, and its blessing comes away with you.

choices.text: Pay the keeper for a rubbing

outcome.text: The keeper makes a rubbing that carries the tablet's blessing.

choices.text: Set it in the market wall

outcome.text: You set the tablet where traders pass. They pay to touch it, and they keep a share for you.

stories.name: Volatile Rig
stories.intro: A rig of pistons and fuel tanks lurches out of an Izzet yard, its operator long gone. Every hit it takes might make it explode. It is coming straight for you.
stories.win: The rig coughs to a halt and lets you take the controls. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It rams you, and its sparks singe your arms.

stories.name: Rogue's Passage
stories.text: A maze without walls where thieves whisper of a prize beyond worth. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Transguild Promenade
stories.text: A promenade where every guild may walk, if each pays its toll. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
